column2: It would seem that the inhabitants of [Root.GetName] have had enough with [Root.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledNameWithNick] and [Root.Holder.TopLiege.GetHerHis] struggles to convince the world that [Root.Holder.TopLiege.GetSheHe] possesses the Mandate of Heaven, as they are in full revolt, seeking to make [Root.Kingdom.GetFullBaseName] independent... and perhaps also to claim the Mandate.
